findings.defect: This can mean he was already a prodigy when he was five; the Korean says he had played piano since he was five.
findings.rationale: 다섯 살 때부터 means “since he was five,” establishing when he began playing rather than only his age when he was a prodigy.
findings.replacement: a piano prodigy who’d been playing since he was five

summary: One minor age-timing detail is less precise than the Korean.
